verdict.rationale: Capacities has a documented Graph view showing how objects connect and the local neighbourhood of an open note, backed by backlinks and block-based linking for exploring connections. However, there is no evidence of filtering the graph by type, tag, or search criteria, which is central to the 'filtered to what I care about' part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit graph filtering/query controls, whole-space graph exploration (vs. local neighbourhood only), and independent hands-on confirmation of graph usability.
